programme.title: Bachelor Informatica - Universiteit van Amsterdam
programme.degree: BSc Informatica, 180 ECTS, 36 months, full-time, Science Park; starts in September (RIO code 56978)
programme.how_found: uva.nl -> Programmes -> Bachelor's -> Informatica (Dutch page); the English short page /en/programmes/bachelors/computer-science/ is its twin ('Read more about this programme in Dutch').
programme.notes: Dutch-taught; the UvA has no English-taught CS bachelor of its own. Admission with a foreign diploma: vwo-level equivalence plus Wiskunde B, English and Dutch at vwo level; non-Dutch speakers must pass NT2-II (or an accepted equivalent). UvA Matching is compulsory.

value.dutch_level: NT2-II state exam (or CNaVT PAT/EDUP C1, PTHO/STRT B2, ITNA B2)

english.quote: International students are required to take a language proficiency examination in Dutch before they are admitted to a degree programme taught in Dutch
english.notes: Dutch-taught programme: the language requirement is Dutch (state exam NT2 programme II). English at vwo level is also required ('Wiskunde B Engels Nederlands'); the UvA English page for Dutch-taught bachelors only points to general 'Language proficiency' (no figure read).

value.description: No grade threshold: a diploma at Dutch vwo level with Wiskunde B, English and Dutch at vwo level.

gpa.quote: Om toegelaten te worden, moet je de volgende vakken op vwo-niveau met certificaat hebben behaald: Wiskunde B Engels Nederlands
gpa.notes: Open (non-numerus-fixus) programme; admission by diploma equivalence and subject requirements, plus compulsory UvA Matching.

deadline.quote: Meld je voor 1 mei aan in Studielink
deadline.notes: Section 'Aanmelden met een buitenlands diploma' (foreign diploma): register in Studielink before 1 May. Printed without a year; the same page gives UvA Matching dates in 2027 ('uiterlijk op 15 juni 2027'), so it describes the September 2027 intake. 'Vanaf 1 oktober tot uiterlijk 1 mei kun je je inschrijven'.

value.population: non-EEA students (instellingscollegegeld), bachelor, Faculteit der Natuurwetenschappen, Wiskunde en Informatica

tuition.quote: Instellingscollegegeld voor niet EER studenten Bachelor € 21.900 Bachelor Scheikunde
tuition.notes: 'Instellingstarieven 2027-2028 per faculteit', Faculty of Science (FNWI) block: non-EEA bachelor EUR 21,900 per academic year. Informatica is an FNWI bachelor (faculty assignment from the programme site, Science Park). Statutory fee 2027-2028 EUR 2,771 for EU/EEA.

scholarship_exists.quote: Outstanding students from outside the EU/EEA can apply for an Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS)
scholarship_exists.notes: UvA-wide merit scholarship for bachelor's students from outside Europe; competitive; continuation needs ~80% of credits per year. The bachelor AMS page links faculty instructions only for Economics and Business, Social and Behavioural Sciences and Psychology - not the Faculty of Science, so it is not shown to be open to Informatica.

scholarship_international.quote: Students who hold a non-EU/EEA passport and have applied for a degree programme at the University of Amsterdam may submit an application for an Amsterdam Merit Scholarship
scholarship_international.notes: Open to non-EU/EEA applicants by design; applications via the Graduate Schools/faculties with faculty-specific deadlines. Caveat: no Faculty of Science bachelor AMS route is listed.
